completeness.why: applyWeekendRule (and its day-string wrapper) takes the enable flag and mode and decides both; getUpcomingDates and the two template sites pass their config objects, getNextDate maps weekendSolve to weekendSolveMode and keeps only its site-unique noSkipWeekend guard.

interface.why: A WeekendRule object { skipWeekend, weekendSolveMode } carries exactly the real variation and the weekendSolve/weekendSolveMode naming difference is mapped explicitly at getNextDate; minor redundancy in applyWeekendRuleToDay re-checking skipWeekend and accepting a nullable day it then parses.

disguised_duplication.where: The old getDateWithSkippedWeekend body is folded into applyWeekendRule rather than kept alongside it; applyWeekendRuleToDay delegates.
